title: Chapter 139: Chat Group For Citizens
content:
Chapter 139: Chat Group For Citizens

Hadro saw that Wang Shuo's reaction was too extreme!

He had never reacted like this before!

Seeing that he had lost his composure, Wang Shuo took a deep breath.

This Xiao Lao Teng is really a profiteer, even more cunning than Hadro.

Damn, 2 gold coins are still a friendly price!

"Sorry, Mr. Hadro, I just thought of something bad. You said it was 80 silver coins, right?"

"Yes." Hadro had to bite the bullet and said.

"Okay, let's do it! Remember, the sooner the better!" Wang Shuo forced a smile.

"Okay, no problem, Lord, just wait for my good news!"

Seeing Wang Shuo so straightforward, Hadro breathed a sigh of relief. Now Wang Shuo is already a big customer of his and should not be offended easily.

After Hadro left, Wang Shuo sat for a long time before calming down.

After calming down, Wang Shuo didn't seem to be as angry as he was at that time.

It turns out that all businessmen are dishonest. After all, if you don't make money, you are a bastard.

If I were in this position, I would probably ask for a lot of money!

But even if it is human nature, Wang Shuo still feels a little uncomfortable.

He must seek justice.

Wang Shuo walked out of the lord's mansion. At this time, two residential buildings had been built, temporarily solving the housing problem of the people.

And in front of the lord's mansion, a huge open space was left for the construction of the central square.

Wang Shuo thought of it at this time. He seemed to have two koi. Such important territory guardian animals should be kept in a safer place.

He turned and walked into the lord's mansion and came to the backyard.

In the newly planted soil, there were unknown flowers and plants, and Yan'er fell to the ground.

Next to a small pond, a few willow trees were newly planted, and it was unknown whether they could survive.

In the pond, the rockery made of a few rocks looked a little casual and uncarved, but it also had a rough charm.

Wang Shuo put the koi into the pond, and immediately, the two little fish swam freely and happily, very smart.

"Agui, do you know what this kind of spiritual beast eats?"

"Lord, you can try to feed it with energy crystals!"

Wang Shuo's eyebrows moved, and he was surprised: "Can such a small mouth eat energy crystals? After all, energy crystals are the size of pigeon eggs, and the texture is extremely hard."

Wang Shuo took out one and threw it into the water. The two koi immediately swam over and took a bite, and actually bit off a small piece.

Looking at the scene in front of him, Wang Shuo smiled.

It's quite interesting!

Wang Shuo thought about it, and took out the "Spring of Life" and placed it directly on the rockery.

There is also a 6G signal base station obtained before, which is also placed in the backyard.

Immediately, the system prompt sounded.

[It is detected that you have built a system network. You can establish a "village chat channel" and the signal covers all your territories. ]

[Please name your "village chat channel". 】

"Leader Chat Group."

["Leader Chat Group" channel, named successfully. 】

Wang Shuo was the first to speak in the group.

"Hello, everyone. I'm Wang Shuo. From today on, we have established a chat group for our Wana Village. Everyone can speak freely in the group."

Duan Wenxi: "Boss is mighty, boss is awesome!"

Suo Yong: "Lord, may you have great fortune and unify the Great Huai Region!"

Wang Shuo: "Suo Yong, you have learned bad things from Duan Wenxi, [smirk]!"

Bai Liliang: "Wow, this is fun. Finally, there is a place to brag and fart. I want to post some messages..."

Gu Liji: "No posting. If you want to post messages, just post them in your mouth."

Wang Shuo: "Aren't you in the ancient battlefield? How come you have a signal from so far away?"

Gu Liji: "Lord, we are back. Ayub said that the monsters that should be swiped have been almost swiped. There are still a few bosses left. I want to come back and ask you for instructions on our next move."

Wang Shuo was thoughtful when he heard this. His expression changed and he walked out of the lord's mansion quickly.
